title: NASA’s Webb captures a bizarre brain-shaped nebula around a dying star
summary: The James Webb Space Telescope has revealed new details in a bizarre nebula that looks like a brain floating in space. Formed by a dying star, the “Exposed Cranium” nebula shows layered gas and a dark central divide that creates its eerie shape.
